# Fixtures

`calc_like.parsing_g.json` is copied from GDBMiner's calc mining output
(`output/calc/trial-0/parsing_g.json` in minh-dng/gdbminer). It is a small
synthetic-calculator grammar mined by GDBMiner and is used only as a converter
fixture. Upstream project is AGPL-3.0; this parent integration is thesis work
on top of that lineage.
